Phase 2: the deck

  • One self-contained HTML file; Reveal.js and Mermaid from pinned CDN versions.
  • Build horizontal slides first, then vertical slides by priority.
  • Verify every slide before calling it done.

Verify every slide

  • Visible, no overflow, no footer collision, diagrams rendered, no console errors.
  • Then look at screenshots.
python3 tools/check-deck.py deck.html --shots shots
